name: Nai Khanom Tom
original_name: ナーイ・カノム・トム
source:
A champion of old-style fighting who secretly participated in a martial arts tournament where roughnecks gather.

She is actually the king of Ayutthaya, but since she rarely appears in public as king, she is hardly noticed.

She taught Yamada Nagamasa, who temporarily lost the ability to use a bow, how to fight with her bare hands.

It seems that Nai Khanom Tom is not her real name but her ring name.
